name: week
title: The week
subtitle: Optometry Practice for Claude Code: the book and what wants a decision, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Booked, next 7 days
sections.note: UNCONFIRMED rows are tomorrow's no-shows unless someone calls.
sections.sql: select to_char(on_date, 'Dy DD Mon') as day, substr(starts_at::text, 1, 5) as at, coalesce(optometrist, 'dispensing') as optometrist, patient, service, coalesce(mbs_item, '') as item, case when status = 'booked' then 'UNCONFIRMED' else status end as state from v_appointments where on_date between current_date and current_date + 7 and status in ('booked', 'confirmed') order by on_date, starts_at

sections.title: Examinations not finalised
sections.note: A consult with no final examination cannot be claimed or defended. Oldest first.
sections.sql: select to_char(on_date, 'DD Mon') as consult, days_since || ' days' as age, patient, optometrist, coalesce(exam_ref, ref) as ref, upper(exam_state) as state from v_exams_due order by on_date

sections.title: Spectacle jobs in flight
sections.note: Late jobs are the lab's; uncollected ones are ours.
sections.sql: select ref, patient, status, lab, to_char(promised_on, 'DD Mon') as promised, case when days_late > 0 then days_late || ' days late' when days_waiting > 0 then 'waiting ' || days_waiting || ' days' else '' end as state, round(balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as owing from v_jobs where status in ('ordered', 'received', 'ready', 'remake') order by ordered_on

sections.title: Recalls due, next 14 days or overdue
sections.sql: select to_char(due_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') as due, patient, kind as recall, contacts, coalesce(phone, email, '') as contact, case when marketing_opt_in then 'message' else 'call' end as how from v_recalls where due_on <= current_date + 14 and next_appt_on is null order by due_on

name: clinical
title: The clinical record
subtitle: Medicare eligibility, prescriptions and recalls, straight off the tables

sections.title: Comprehensive consult: when Medicare pays again
sections.note: 10910 once in 36 months under 65; 10911 once in 12 months at 65 and over. Only consults on this record count.
sections.sql: select name as patient, age, routine_item as item, coalesce(last_comprehensive_item || ' on ' || to_char(last_comprehensive_on, 'DD Mon YYYY'), 'none on record') as last, coalesce(to_char(eligible_from, 'DD Mon YYYY'), 'now') as claimable_from from v_medicare_eligibility order by eligible_from nulls first, name

sections.title: Prescriptions expiring in 60 days, or expired
sections.sql: select ref, patient, replace(kind, '_', ' ') as kind, to_char(expires_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') as expires, days_to_expiry as days from v_prescriptions where status = 'active' and days_to_expiry <= 60 and days_to_expiry > -90 order by expires_on

sections.title: Clinical flags on the book
sections.sql: select name as patient, age, concat_ws(', ', case when diabetic then 'diabetic' end, conditions, case when dva_number is not null then 'DVA' end) as flags, to_char(last_exam_on, 'DD Mon YYYY') as last_exam, coalesce(to_char(next_appt_on, 'DD Mon'), 'NOTHING BOOKED') as next from v_patients where status = 'active' and (diabetic or conditions is not null) order by name

sections.title: Claims by state
sections.note: Ready claims are money in a drawer; lodged claims past three weeks are a query.
sections.sql: select funder, status, count(*) as claims, round(sum(amount_cents) / 100.0, 2) as amount, max(coalesce(days_lodged, days_since_service)) || ' days' as oldest, sum(case when status = 'ready' and exam_status <> 'final' then 1 else 0 end) as blocked_by_exam from v_claims where status <> 'paid' group by funder, status order by funder, status

sections.title: Patients owing
sections.sql: select ref, patient, to_char(due_on, 'DD Mon') as due, round(balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as owing, case when days_overdue > 0 then days_overdue || ' days overdue' else 'not yet due' end as state from v_invoices where payer = 'patient' and status = 'sent' and balance_cents > 0 order by days_overdue desc

sections.title: Invoiced, last 30 days
sections.sql: select line, round(sum(takings_cents) / 100.0, 2) as invoiced from v_takings where on_date > current_date - 30 group by line order by invoiced desc

sections.title: Stock to reorder, or not moving
sections.sql: select sku, brand || ' ' || name as item, on_hand, reorder_at, moved_90, age_days || ' days' as age, round(value_cents / 100.0, 2) as at_cost, case when low then 'REORDER' else 'NOT MOVING' end as flag from v_stock where active and (low or (kind = 'frame' and on_hand > 0 and age_days > 365 and moved_90 = 0)) order by flag, sku
